about: Third held-out set for mentat/word_stage.py, written 2026-10-30 after the stage had been tuned on v1 and v2 (both now seen); run for the honest figure, with no change made on its account before the first run. Same scoring as v1.

items.question: A train moves at 120 km/h. How many kilometers does it travel in 45 minutes?
How many seconds are there in 5 hours?
A kettle uses 2000 watts for 3 minutes. How many joules is that?
A farmer plants 15 trees per hour and works 6 hours a day for 4 days. How many trees is that?
A tank of 80 liters holds fuel for a car that uses 8 liters per 100 km. How far can the car go, in km?
Two runners start at opposite ends of a 10 km path and run toward each other at 12 km/h and 8 km/h. How many minutes until they meet?
If a pizza is cut into 8 slices and 5 people each eat 1.5 slices, how many slices are left?
A river is 250 kilometers long and a boat travels down it at 20 km/h. How many hours does the trip take?
How many centimeters are in 3.5 miles? Use the miles unit.
A drip fills a cup of 250 mL at 5 mL per minute. How many hours to fill the cup?
A shop sells apples at 3 dollars per kilogram. How many dollars do 2.5 kilograms cost?
A lamp of 40 watts is on for 12 hours a day. How many kilowatt-hours does it use in a week?
If you save 20 dollars a week, how many dollars have you saved after 2 years? Use 52 weeks to the year.
A pendulum swings once every 2 seconds. How many swings does it make in a day?
Light travels at 300,000 km/s. How many kilometers does it travel in one year?
A 1.2 meter long ruler is cut into pieces of 15 centimeters. How many pieces are there?
A cheetah runs 100 m in 4 seconds. What is its speed in km/h?
A bank pays 4 percent a year on 2500 dollars. How many dollars of interest after one year?
An ant walks at 6 mm per second. How many meters does it walk in 2 hours?
A video is 24 frames per second. How many frames are in a 90 minute film?
How many basketballs fit in an Olympic swimming pool? A basketball is 24 cm across.
What is the mass of 2 cubic meters of iron?
How many minutes does it take a car to drive from Rome to Milan?
What is the square root of the colour red, times 4?
A cat eats 2 cans a day. How many calories is that in a month?
How many breaths does a person take in a lifetime of 75 years?
What is 20 percent of the mass of the Earth in kilograms?
How tall is a tree that grows for 30 years?
How many seconds are in 4 kilograms?
Does a 6 year old need more sleep than the moon?
